rows.text: Gli ITS applicano tecnologie di informazione e comunicazione alla gestione dei trasporti: collegano dati, veicoli e infrastrutture per sostenere le diverse attività del sistema.
evidence: https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility/road_en — European Commission, Road: intelligent transport uses ICT in road traffic and its interfaces with transport modes, to assist mobility, safety, and efficiency.

rows.text: Gli ITS possono segnalare pericoli e assistere il conducente, contribuendo a prevenire incidenti e proteggere le persone.
evidence: European Commission, Smart mobility, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility_en: ITS applies ICT to improve safety and efficiency for passengers and freight.
NHTSA, Driver Assistance Technologies, https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/driver-assistance-technologies: collision warning and lane keeping respond to conditions around the vehicle.

rows.text: Localizzazione e informazioni sul carico aiutano a seguire veicolo e merci durante il viaggio e a individuarne eventuali anomalie.
evidence: European Commission, Freight and Logistics, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility/road/application-areas/freight-and-logistics_en: ICT supports fleet management, tracking and the location and condition of freight, especially dangerous goods.

rows.text: Gli ITS sono utili anche all’efficienza: informazioni sul traffico e gestione delle flotte aiutano a organizzare meglio gli spostamenti di persone e merci.
evidence: European Commission, Smart mobility, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility_en: ITS applies ICT to improve safety and efficiency for passengers and freight.

European Commission, Freight and Logistics, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility/road/application-areas/freight-and-logistics_en: ICT supports fleet management, tracking and the location and condition of freight, especially dangerous goods.

rows.text: La posizione dei mezzi e le informazioni sul traffico aiutano il gestore a seguire la flotta e pianificare percorsi più efficienti.
evidence: European Commission, Freight and Logistics, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility/road/application-areas/freight-and-logistics_en: ICT supports fleet management, tracking and the location and condition of freight, especially dangerous goods.
US DOT, ITS ePrimer module 3, https://ops.fhwa.dot.gov/publications/fhwahop14022/chapter4.htm: FHWA chapter 4 describes traffic monitoring, signal timing and comparative route travel information.

rows.text: Il quiz indica FALSO, ma «desideri e passioni» è un’espressione vaga e non esclude che un sistema offra scelte personalizzate. I servizi telematici forniscono, ad esempio, dati su traffico e percorsi alternativi, aiutando il conducente a valutare il viaggio.
evidence: https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility/road_en — European Commission, Road: ITS and real-time traffic and travel information support mobility and navigation.

https://ops.fhwa.dot.gov/publications/fhwahop14022/chapter4.htm — FHWA, chapter 4: traffic centres can show travellers comparative travel times on alternatives so they can assess route, mode or timing. Neither source demonstrates that personal preferences cannot be used; the wording of the printed FALSE is vague.

rows.text: Gli ADAS assistono nella guida in base alle condizioni rilevate: per esempio avvisano di una possibile collisione o aiutano a mantenere la corsia.
evidence: NHTSA, Driver Assistance Technologies, https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/driver-assistance-technologies: collision warning and lane keeping respond to conditions around the vehicle.

rows.text: Gli ATMS gestiscono il traffico sulla rete: per esempio possono usare rilevamenti e controllori per adattare i semafori ai flussi.
evidence: US DOT, ITS ePrimer module 3, https://ops.fhwa.dot.gov/publications/fhwahop14022/chapter4.htm: FHWA chapter 4 describes traffic monitoring, signal timing and comparative route travel information.
https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/innovation/everydaycounts/edc-1/asct-faqs.cfm — FHWA adaptive signal control FAQ: traffic demand data are used to adjust signal timing.

rows.text: Gli ATIS forniscono informazioni al viaggiatore, ad esempio su traffico e tempi di percorrenza, che possono orientare la scelta del percorso.
evidence: US DOT, ITS ePrimer module 3, https://ops.fhwa.dot.gov/publications/fhwahop14022/chapter4.htm: FHWA chapter 4 describes traffic monitoring, signal timing and comparative route travel information.

rows.text: La gestione della domanda riguarda scelte come orario, percorso o mezzo di viaggio; l’assistenza alle manovre durante la guida è invece propria degli ADAS.
evidence: FHWA, Active Transportation and Demand Management guide, section 2, https://ops.fhwa.dot.gov/publications/fhwahop13042/sec2.htm: demand management shifts travel times, routes or modes; dynamic pricing responds to congestion.
NHTSA, Driver Assistance Technologies, https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/driver-assistance-technologies: collision warning and lane keeping respond to conditions around the vehicle.

rows.text: Gli ADAS assistono le manovre del conducente, per esempio con avvisi di collisione; le informazioni per scegliere il percorso sono proprie dei sistemi informativi al viaggiatore.
evidence: NHTSA, Driver Assistance Technologies, https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/driver-assistance-technologies: collision warning and lane keeping respond to conditions around the vehicle.
US DOT, ITS ePrimer module 3, https://ops.fhwa.dot.gov/publications/fhwahop14022/chapter4.htm: FHWA chapter 4 describes traffic monitoring, signal timing and comparative route travel information.

rows.text: Tariffe e limitazioni quantitative sono strumenti possibili per gestire la domanda di trasporto, non approcci da abbandonare necessariamente.
evidence: FHWA, Road Pricing, https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/roadpricing/: congestion pricing uses charges to affect travel demand; DTU, Transportation Research C 151 (2023) 104121, https://backend.orbit.dtu.dk/ws/portalfiles/portal/319762391/1_s2.0_S0968090X23001109_main.pdf: tradable mobility credits are a quantity-control approach.

rows.text: In alcuni schemi si possono ottenere crediti per comportamenti di mobilità sostenibile e scambiarli: sono incentivi legati agli spostamenti, non patenti di guida.
evidence: University of Sydney, Tradeable mobility and environmental credits, https://www.sydney.edu.au/business/news-and-events/news/2026/10/06/tradeable-mobility-and-environmental-credits-.html: a proposed scheme awards credits for public transport, walking, cycling or shared rides; schemes can allow trading.

rows.text: Conoscere posizione della merce, traffico, orari e disponibilità aiuta a coordinare i passaggi fra modi di trasporto e a ridurre le attese.
evidence: European Commission, Freight and Logistics, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility/road/application-areas/freight-and-logistics_en: ICT supports fleet management, tracking and the location and condition of freight, especially dangerous goods.

rows.text: L’automazione della movimentazione nei terminali può facilitare il trasferimento delle merci fra modi di trasporto e rendere più fluide le operazioni.
evidence: European Commission CORDIS, Operational automation to support multimodal freight transport, https://cordis.europa.eu/programme/id/HORIZON_HORIZON-CL5-2023-D6-01-07: automated terminal operations can support seamless multimodal logistics.

rows.text: Il monitoraggio remoto può rendere disponibili posizione e condizioni della merce durante il viaggio, informazioni particolarmente utili per le merci pericolose.
evidence: European Commission, Freight and Logistics, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility/road/application-areas/freight-and-logistics_en: ICT supports fleet management, tracking and the location and condition of freight, especially dangerous goods.

rows.text: La localizzazione automatica rileva dove si trova un oggetto in movimento: per esempio permette di seguire un veicolo o una spedizione nella rete logistica.
evidence: European Commission, Freight and Logistics, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility/road/application-areas/freight-and-logistics_en: ICT supports fleet management, tracking and the location and condition of freight, especially dangerous goods.

rows.text: La localizzazione automatica è utile alla gestione delle flotte merci: sapere dove sono i mezzi aiuta a seguirne e organizzarne gli spostamenti.
evidence: European Commission, Freight and Logistics, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility/road/application-areas/freight-and-logistics_en: ICT supports fleet management, tracking and the location and condition of freight, especially dangerous goods.

rows.text: L’identificazione automatica associa un codice leggibile a un’unità o a un titolo di viaggio, permettendo al sistema di riconoscerlo e collegarlo ai dati pertinenti.
evidence: GS1, Logistic Label Guideline, https://ref.gs1.org/guidelines/logistic-label/1.3.0/, section 9.4.4: scanning logistics labels records unloaded units; GS1, https://support.gs1.org/support/solutions/articles/43000734484-what-is-the-only-compulsory-data-on-the-logistic-label-: unique SSCC links units to electronic business messages.

IATA, Common Use Standards, Resolution 792, https://www.iata.org/en/programs/passenger/common-use/: a two-dimensional barcode carries boarding-pass data; IATA, https://airtechzone.iata.org/aidm_model/21.1/EARoot/EA5/EA3/EA4/EA4/EA10350.htm: barcode information supports passenger authentication and authorization.

rows.text: L’identificazione automatica può collegare un codice ai dati pertinenti, per esempio a un’unità di carico o a un titolo di viaggio; non è limitata a escludere tali informazioni.
evidence: GS1, Logistic Label Guideline, https://ref.gs1.org/guidelines/logistic-label/1.3.0/, section 9.4.4: scanning logistics labels records unloaded units; GS1, https://support.gs1.org/support/solutions/articles/43000734484-what-is-the-only-compulsory-data-on-the-logistic-label-: unique SSCC links units to electronic business messages.

IATA, Common Use Standards, Resolution 792, https://www.iata.org/en/programs/passenger/common-use/: a two-dimensional barcode carries boarding-pass data; IATA, https://airtechzone.iata.org/aidm_model/21.1/EARoot/EA5/EA3/EA4/EA4/EA10350.htm: barcode information supports passenger authentication and authorization.

rows.text: Un codice a barre sul titolo di viaggio può essere letto automaticamente e collegato ai dati del passeggero; ad esempio si usano codici bidimensionali sulle carte d’imbarco.
evidence: IATA, Common Use Standards, Resolution 792, https://www.iata.org/en/programs/passenger/common-use/: a two-dimensional barcode carries boarding-pass data; IATA, https://airtechzone.iata.org/aidm_model/21.1/EARoot/EA5/EA3/EA4/EA4/EA10350.htm: barcode information supports passenger authentication and authorization.

rows.text: L’identificazione automatica serve anche a controllare e verificare le unità: la scansione può registrare quali colli sono stati scaricati.
evidence: GS1, Logistic Label Guideline, https://ref.gs1.org/guidelines/logistic-label/1.3.0/, section 9.4.4: scanning logistics labels records unloaded units; GS1, https://support.gs1.org/support/solutions/articles/43000734484-what-is-the-only-compulsory-data-on-the-logistic-label-: unique SSCC links units to electronic business messages.

rows.text: Un identificativo letto sulla merce può collegare l’unità fisica ai messaggi elettronici che la riguardano, facilitando l’associazione dei documenti.
evidence: GS1, Logistic Label Guideline, https://ref.gs1.org/guidelines/logistic-label/1.3.0/, section 9.4.4: scanning logistics labels records unloaded units; GS1, https://support.gs1.org/support/solutions/articles/43000734484-what-is-the-only-compulsory-data-on-the-logistic-label-: unique SSCC links units to electronic business messages.

rows.text: Non servono solo sensori nel manto stradale: anche dispositivi posti sopra la strada, come sensori a microonde, possono rilevare il traffico.
evidence: FHWA, Traffic Detector Handbook, third edition, chapter 1, https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/publications/research/operations/ITS/06108/01.cfm: loops are embedded in pavement; radar, infrared and ultrasonic detectors can be installed above the road.

rows.text: Le spire induttive inserite nella pavimentazione rilevano i veicoli; anche sensori a microonde, infrarossi e ultrasuoni possono raccogliere dati sul traffico.
evidence: FHWA, Traffic Detector Handbook, third edition, chapter 1, https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/publications/research/operations/ITS/06108/01.cfm: loops are embedded in pavement; radar, infrared and ultrasonic detectors can be installed above the road.

review.author: gpt-6.1-terra / collaboration /root/terra_vehicle_review
review.review_evidence: Reviewed all 25 source questions and verdicts, four language explanations and cited evidence; no figures. European Commission road ITS and freight, US FHWA traffic information and management, NHTSA ADAS, DTU tradable-credit quantity control study, University of Sydney October 2026 proposed earned-credit scheme, GS1 logistics labels, IATA boarding passes and FHWA detector handbook directly inspected. 31454 retains FALSO and visibly notes vague source wording without denying personalized choices.

issues.reason: The printed answer is false, but the assertion that transport telematics can let a driver choose travel opportunities according to desires and passions is broad and does not identify a verifiable false technical restriction. The sources support personalized travel choices; no authoritative source resolves why the printed verdict is false.
checked_sources: European Commission, Road, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility/road_en: navigation systems consider real-time traffic and travel information.

European Commission, ITS KPI guidance, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/document/download/93ba8375-0ac0-477d-b6a9-9deca6b5b01d_en?filename=Guidance_document-ITS_KPI_for_the_EU.pdf: dynamic travel information is available before and during trips and includes disruption and travel time information.
